notes.title: Iron Onslaught v0.5.0.0 - A Brand New Look
notes.content: [h3]Iron Onslaught has been updated to [b]v0.5.0.0[/b], and with this update comes a brand new look[/h3][p][/p][h2]New Images[/h2][p]I remade every image for Iron Onslaught to help represent the gameplay and enemies you'll fight[/p][h2][/h2][h2]Updated Time Achievements[/h2][p]I changed the time achievements to 1 hour, 3 hours, 5 hours, and 10 hours because, well, 72 hours was a bit too long (keep in mind that the time doesn't reflect the time you've played overall, it's how long you've survived in your save)[/p][h2][/h2][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the grenade-image issue once more so that it displays the text that appears after you throw it (which is either [b][i]3 mins[/i][/b] or [b][i]10 mins [/i][/b]depending on what grenade you threw)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the crosshair for 3 of the guns (the SMG, shotgun, and minigun) to be more accurate to the bullet's projectile[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Bots once more to make sure they don't attack you when they're dead since they're shot to Narnia with a 9mm SMG[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the delay for the other Steam achievements to 0.3 seconds because 0.2 seconds was too quick for the game to unlock more than 1 achievement[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New Pics For New Update
notes.content: [p][b]There will be some new pics coming when I release the new update, these new pictures will be screenshots of the game to represent the gameplay and enemies you'll fight in Iron Onslaught, compared to the pictures now, which don't represent the game in the slightest, it's just a toaster with text on the bottom[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535023/f72c21a5774366207a1dece419efc8e071bb234f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="dA_lNKaQgdo;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Iron Onslaught v0.4.0.0
notes.content: [h2]Map & UI Polish[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a patch on the desert map that wasn't the right material[/p][/*][*][p]Made the crosshair dynamic to the weapon. In other words, the crosshair will move locations to center where the bullet is going[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the text when uploading to the leaderboard to show the time when it'll finish before exiting to the main menu (which is 3 seconds)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the timer would reset at 60 seconds instead of 59[/p][previewyoutube="5xpCyx1h3r0;full"][/previewyoutube][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the grenade image would disappear from the UI (this has been a re-occurring bug because I couldn't find the source of the issue, so please email/message me if it still occurs)[/p][/*][/list]

So the mechs are now your "friend" :)[/p][/*][/list][h2]Main Menu Bug[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where in [b][i]Mouse/Controller[/i][/b], your mouse sensitivity would show as 0%[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Iron Onslaught v0.3.5.0
notes.content:
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the friendly-fire damage that the mechs do to the bots. They now do less damage
[*] The mechs' heads and bullets are faster
[*] The railgun can kill more than one enemy
[*] Fixed an issue where when you resumed the game, the grenade image wouldn't appear
[*] Fixed an issue where, despite the bots being dead, you could still run into them and they would block you from getting the armor/HP
[*] Decreased the chances of getting ammo when you use the grenades or railgun
[/list]
[h2]UI Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Stats are now visible when you pause the game, so there's no need to exit to the main menu  to see your stats
[/list]

notes.title: The 7-Hour Free Trial Has Released
notes.content: [h3]Check out the free trial today[/h3][p]The 7-Hour free trial for Iron Onslaught has been released, go check it out today![/p]

notes.title: Iron Onslaught Now Has A 7-Hour Free Trial
notes.content:
Iron Onslaught now has a 7-hour free trial, where for 7 in-game hours, you can play the game to see for yourself if you wish to buy the full product.

The free trial does not include the following
[list]
[*] Achievements
[*] Cloud saves
[*] The Steam Leaderboard
[/list]
The release date for the free trial is June 6 at 10:00 A.M. Visit [url=https://saudadesoftware.com/]saudadesoftware.com[/url] to see the countdown.
